# {name} docs

> {name} lets two businesses that do not know each other trust each other before they meet, wherever being seen
> costs something and a lot is at stake. It works in three steps: a check of each side, a private match, and an
> introduction only when both say yes. These are its developer docs: how a platform embeds {name} or builds its own
> interface on the Space API.

This file is a plain-text summary of the developer site for language models. It makes no claim beyond the pages it
links to, and every sentence is true on the day of the site's status check (see Status). The full text of every
English page is in [llms-full.txt](/llms-full.txt). What {name} is, for readers who are not developers, is on
[sensalio.de](https://sensalio.de/en). The developer docs are in English; the start page, Developers, Status, the
changelog and the legal pages are also in German, Spanish, Italian and French under /de, /es, /it and /fr.

## Not published yet

The open-core repository is not public and its packages are not on npm; the licence is not chosen yet. Hosted access
for other platforms is coming soon. The examples run against a local sample space with made-up example data.

## Docs

- [Docs home](/developers/docs): the index of the docs.
- [Quickstart (5 minutes)](/developers/docs/guides/embed-in-five-minutes): the shortest embed, one script and one
  element on a page, and the developer quickstart through a local sample space.
- [Widget](/developers/docs/reference/embed): the embed's attributes, the React component and the recipes for plain
  HTML, Astro, Next.js and WordPress, and what an integrator tells its visitors about privacy.
- [SDK](/developers/docs/reference/sdk): the client for a platform's server, typed by the contract, and webhooks.
- [CLI](/developers/docs/cli): the command-line tool, built, not published.
- [Protocol](/developers/docs/protocol): the line between the open part and the hosted service.
- [API reference](/developers/docs/reference/space-api): the Space API's routes, generated from its contract.
- [What is open, what is hosted](/developers/docs/open-and-hosted): the widget, the SDK, the CLI and the protocol
  description as open source; the checks, the checked history, the matching and the billing as a service {name}
  hosts.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the headline, the quickstart, a demo of "both say yes" with two fictional businesses, in the browser
  only, and the shortest embed.
- [Developers](/developers): the shortest embed, an SDK example, and what is not available yet.
- [Status](/status): dated, which parts run on the synthetic test space, which are built or in the contract, which
  are planned.
- [Changelog](/changelog): what is new, one dated entry per product step, each with where it stands.
- [Privacy notice](/privacy), [Imprint](/imprint) and [Contact](/contact): in preparation.
